title: Pagination skips an item
hints: Count the products on page 1 by hand. Which one is missing?
Check what slice(start, end) returns. Does it include the item at index end?
slice stops before end, so end shouldn't be adjusted by one.

hiddenTestRules.paginate > shows every product exactly o: Every product must appear on exactly one page, in order.
hiddenTestRules.paginate > starts page 2 right after pag: Every product must appear on exactly one page, in order.
hiddenTestRules.paginate > works with one product per pa: Page size can be any number, including 1.
hiddenTestRules.paginate > regression: an empty list sti: An empty list still has one (empty) page.
hiddenTestRules.showingLabel > describes the last, parti: The label under the list shows which products the page holds, like "Showing 21–25 of 25" on a last, partial page.
hiddenTestRules.showingLabel > describes a middle page: The label under the list shows which products the page holds
